raw.description:
Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join the Broker Terms team.

You’ll build the systems behind every offer iwoca makes through brokers, and see your work in the terms each business gets.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Broker Terms is a growing team that owns the full offer terms strategy for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – both first-time and repeat customers. It sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the offer user interface (UI) brokers use in the Introducer Portal. The broker network is iwoca's biggest acquisition channel, and the team is directly responsible for the terms that win those customers.

The team is small and interdisciplinary – commercial strategy, engineering and data science. It turns business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into timely decisions. It works on short-term gains and longer-term bets, and judges both by Customer Lifetime Value – what a business is worth to iwoca across all its borrowing.

There are no fixed office days, and the team meets up for lunch once or twice a month.

The role

As a full-stack engineer in Broker Terms, you'll make changes across iwoca's codebase wherever they'd improve an offer. Most of it is backend – the code that calculates each offer's terms – with some frontend on the UI where brokers see them.

You'll own features and projects from scoping and design through to production, and choose how to build them. You'll help decide what goes on the team's roadmap. You'll learn from the team's experienced engineers, and from the people who price broker offers.

The team is light on process – a daily stand-up, a weekly meeting and regular retrospectives – and you'll have a say in how it works. Brokers see your changes in the Introducer Portal, and A/B tests show you which ones raised Customer Lifetime Value. Your work helps businesses get the funding they need.

Live project examples:

  • Model-based pricing. Developing the systems that let a model set bespoke pricing for each customer.

  • No-fee test. Testing how the product performs without drawdown fees, and how that changes the way customers repay.

  • Loan durations. Building longer-duration Flexi-Loans with flexible repayments.

  • Offer display. Improving how offers appear to brokers and customers – a better journey, and easier testing for the team's data scientists.

  • Commission systems. Upgrading iwoca's broker commission systems.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built backend systems that run in production, ideally in Python, Django and PostgreSQL. You've modelled their data with performance and maintenance in mind.

  • Frontend engineering. You've built and maintained user interfaces in production, ideally in TypeScript and React.

  • Ownership. You've taken features end to end, and kept them working once people relied on them.

  • Trade-offs. You've weighed delivery speed against the long-term health of a system, and can explain what you chose and why.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • DevOps. You've used containers and CI/CD pipelines to deploy your code.

  • Experimentation. You've worked on A/B tests or other experiments, and used the results to decide what to build next.

  • Product thinking. You've found the business need behind a feature request, and planned the technical work to meet it.

  • Financial services. You've worked on lending, payments or pricing systems.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

raw.title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
raw.description:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself. 

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the role include:

Deliver

  • Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

  • Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

  • Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

  • Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

  • Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

  • Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

  • Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

  • Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

  • Produce clear technical and customer-facing deliverables, including detection strategies, use case catalogues and coverage assessments

Collaborate

  • Work directly with customers as a trusted technical consultant

  • Lead workshops covering detection engineering, use case design and SOC maturity

  • Guide customers on improving detection coverage and aligning to MITRE ATT&CK

  • Clearly explain detection strategies, gaps and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams to ensure smooth integration of delivered detections and automations

  • Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

  • Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

  • Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

  • Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes


Job Requirements
 

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SIEM engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, with Microsoft Sentinel preferred 

  • Experience writing detection logic using KQL or similar query languages 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing SOAR automations and playbooks such as Logic Apps, Cortex XSOAR or similar 

  • Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell or similar, including working with APIs 

  • Experience designing detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK 

  • Strong understanding of detection coverage and how log sources map to the attack lifecycle

  • Experience with XDR or EDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or Cortex 

  • Understanding of cloud environments, particularly Azure, and associated security telemetry 

  • Experience working in customer-facing or consultancy roles 

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Technical Competencies

  • SIEM and XDR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto XSIAM or XDR, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne 

  • SOAR development, including automation and playbook design using platforms such as Palo Alto XSOAR or similar 

  • Scripting and integration using Python, PowerShell or similar, including API-driven automation 

  • Detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, including use case design, ruleset development and coverage assessment 

  • Log source mapping and normalisation to support detection use cases 

  • Network Detection and Response technologies such as Vectra AI, Corelight or similar 

  • Cloud security and telemetry, particularly within Azure environments 

  • Threat intelligence integration and enrichment to support detection and response 

  • Development of customer playbooks and response workflows aligned to SOC operations 

  • General awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-driven security tooling and their application within detection and response

title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
description: À propos de Brixio Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes. L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans. La mission L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans. Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe. Responsabilités Cadrage :  animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration). Déploiement Cloudflare One :  Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security. Migrations :  remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs. Intégrations :  fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client. OT et industrie :  sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques. Sécurité des usages IA :  appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA). Livraison et passation :  documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca. Rigueur projet :  travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One. Industrialisation :  contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants. Requirements Profil indispensable Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue. SASE en production :  au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE. Expérience :  3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels. Fondamentaux réseau :  TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu. Identité :  SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta. Poste de travail :  déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture. Relation client :  capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire. Langues :  français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale). Mobilité :  déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe. Atouts Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée). Automatisation :  Terraform, API, scripts Python. Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels. Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA. Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers). Évolution et ce que Brixio offre Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio. Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps). Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge. Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international. Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans. Processus de recrutement Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA).   • Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie IT, en assurant son alignement avec les enjeux métiers, technologiques et les orientations du Groupe ;

  • Analyser l'existant (As-Is) et définir une vision cible (To-Be), en identifiant les axes de transformation et les opportunités d'optimisation ;

  • Structurer les piliers stratégiques IT et les décliner en initiatives, trajectoires de transformation et roadmaps ;

  • Conduire des analyses stratégiques transverses : architecture, Data & IA, cybersécurité, infrastructure, operating model, sourcing et delivery ;

  • Challenger les orientations techniques, fonctionnelles et organisationnelles des différentes parties prenantes ;

  • Préparer et animer des workshops stratégiques avec les responsables IT, les métiers et les experts ;

  • Identifier les risques, dépendances et arbitrages, et formuler des recommandations argumentées à destination du management.


CIO Office / Communication exécutive & Gouvernance

Vous interviendrez également directement auprès du Top Management afin de :

  • Concevoir des présentations PowerPoint de très haut niveau, destinées aux CIO, Heads of IT et instances de direction ;

  • Transformer des sujets complexes en messages stratégiques clairs, synthétiques et impactants ;

  • Préparer les instances de gouvernance : Steering Committees, Executive Reviews et workshops de direction ;

  • Contribuer aux échanges avec le Top Management, en présentant, argumentant et défendant les orientations proposées ;

  • Assurer la revue critique des livrables stratégiques, aussi bien sur le fond (analyses, cohérence, recommandations) que sur la forme (storytelling, qualité visuelle) ;

  • Produire des synthèses exécutives et supports d'aide à la décision, facilitant les arbitrages du management ;

  • Contribuer au suivi de la déclinaison opérationnelle de la stratégie IT.

Vos compétences

Outils et environnement

  • PowerPoint — maîtrise avancée indispensable : présentations exécutives, storytelling stratégique, visualisation de données et qualité graphique ;

  • Excel et Word : analyses, business cases et notes stratégiques ;

  • Outils collaboratifs : Teams, SharePoint, Confluence, Jira ;

  • Bonne connaissance des frameworks IT Strategy, IT Governance, Target Operating Model (TOM) et IT Roadmap ;

  • Culture IT transverse : Cloud, Data & IA, cybersécurité, architecture SI, infrastructure et IT Operations.

Description du profil

Le profil recherché dispose idéalement des compétences suivantes :

  • Expérience confirmée en IT Strategy, CIO Advisory, CIO Office ou conseil en transformation IT ;

  • Excellente capacité d'analyse, de structuration et de synthèse, avec une véritable hauteur de vue stratégique ;

  • Esprit critique et capacité à challenger des sujets techniques, fonctionnels et organisationnels ;

  • Excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint, avec la capacité à produire des supports exécutifs dignes d'un cabinet de conseil en stratégie ;

  • Communication orale et écrite irréprochable, avec une réelle aisance face au Top Management ;

  • Très bonne compréhension des enjeux IT et métiers, permettant de dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs variés ;

  • Capacité à structurer une réflexion, défendre des recommandations et faciliter les prises de décision ;

  • Autonomie, proactivité, rigueur et exigence élevée sur la qualité des livrables ;

  • Excellent niveau de français et d'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Une expérience en cabinet de conseil en stratégie ou transformation IT constitue un véritable atout.

description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary As a Business Development Representative at Dust, you'll be instrumental in generating the qualified pipeline that fuels our rapid growth. This isn't a typical BDR role—you'll be pioneering AI-native sales development, using Dust's own platform daily to transform how prospecting and qualification work. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from 60 to 180 people, working directly with technical leaders and founders at scale-ups and enterprise companies to connect their challenges to Dust's value. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization. What you'll do Drive qualified pipeline generation Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition Own the qualification and handoff process Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team Experiment and optimize the sales motion Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates Be a Dust power user Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. Aptitude 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets Attitude Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better Agency Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization.

What you'll do

Drive qualified pipeline generation

  • Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies

  • Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers

  • Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition

Own the qualification and handoff process

  • Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers

  • Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps

  • Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team

Experiment and optimize the sales motion

  • Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works

  • Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts

  • Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates

Be a Dust power user

  • Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow

  • Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills

  • Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage

  • You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences

  • Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach

  • Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

Attitude

  • Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge

  • Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility

  • Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create

  • Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude

  • Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better

Agency

  • Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told

  • Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end

  • Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information

  • Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked

  • Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet « Métrologie des réseaux augmentée par l'IA générative et l'apprentissage automatique pour les réseaux autonomes », qui vise à explorer les apports de l’intelligence artificielle appliquée à la métrologie et au diagnostic réseau, nous recrutons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant au sein de notre Département Informatique (campus de Brest).   En collaboration avec l’équipe du projet et l'équipe ERMINE du laboratoire IRISA, vous explorerez le potentiel de nouvelles approches en IA (IA générative, apprentissage automatique) pour la métrologie des réseaux. Vous développerez et structurerez un ou plusieurs axes de recherche conjoints (diagnostic QoS, optimisation du split computing, supervision de CDN) et valoriserez vos travaux par des publications et du code. Enfin, vous ferez la passerelle vers la pédagogie en encadrant des étudiants et en participant à la dissémination scientifique. Job title: Senior Data Engineer

Department: Data team

Reports to: Lead Data Engineer

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Permanent, local and full-time 

Starting date: ASAP 2026

PUR Description 

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

 

About the role 

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. 

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. 

 

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: 

 

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

  • Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

  • Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

  • Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

  • Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.

Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding.

Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals.

🎯 Your mission

You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product.

Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production systems.

You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

Responsibilities

Build AI-powered product features

  • Design and ship AI features used directly by lawyers

  • Be at the bleeing edge of the agentic stack: memory, sandboxes, code mode, lots of tools, subagents…

  • Turn prototypes and experiments into production-ready feature

Work with complex data

  • Extract, structure and reason over large volumes of unstructured legal documents

  • Build robust data and document-processing pipelines

  • Experiment with different models and approaches to improve accuracy and reliability

Make AI work in production

  • Evaluate and improve agent outcomes through testing, evals and iteration

  • Optimize systems for quality, latency and cost

  • Build the backend services and infrastructure needed to run AI reliably at scale

Shape the product

  • Work directly with the founders and users to understand real-world problems

  • Move quickly from problem → experiment → production (think days, not weeks)

  • Take ownership of your projects from exploration to deployment

🤩 This role is for you if

We're looking for a strong software or AI engineer with 2+ years of experience who wants to build real-world AI products at the forefront of the agentic stack.

You like working close to founders and users, making pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping software that actually runs in production.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong software engineering foundation, ideally with Typescript and experience shipping production systems

  • Have experience with agents and/or evals and frameworks like Mastra, Eve, Pydantic, Langchain, etc…

  • Can take an AI problem from experimentation to production

  • Enjoy solving problems with no clear solution

  • Have a strong product mindset and care about user impact

  • Are autonomous and pragmatic, comfortable navigating early-stage ambiguity and shipping fast

⚙️ Our tech stack

Our stack is designed to support AI-first workflows and production reliability.

  • Backend & Frontend: TypeScript, Node.js, React, tRPC

  • Infrastructure: AWS (Terraform)

  • Data & AI: Mastra, Bedrock

  • Database: Postgres

You don't need to master every tool — what matters is your ability to design robust systems, learn fast, and make sound technical trade-offs.

💎 What we offer

  • Build alongside a strong AI expert: Work closely with Alexandre, our CTO, who has deep expertise in AI agents, and turn cutting-edge AI into production systems.

  • Ownership & Impact: As the second engineering hire, you'll have real influence on the product and technical direction

  • Bring AI to real users: Build production AI systems that solve real problems in a complex, high-stakes domain

  • Hexa ecosystem: Access to expertise, resources, and network from one of Europe's leading startup studios

  • Competitive package: Attractive salary + meaningful equity

  • Paris-based team: Work alongside the founding team in our office

  • Growth: Opportunity to grow into a technical leadership role as the team scales

title: Stage - Finance Operations Intern
description: En rejoignant l’équipe Finance de Matera, tu découvriras les coulisses financières d’une start-up et contribueras chaque jour au bon fonctionnement de ses opérations ! Remboursements clients, facturation, suivi de la trésorerie ou fiabilité des données : tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au contact de l’équipe et des demandes du quotidien. En tant que stagiaire FinOps , tu seras accompagné·e par Valent, Head of Finance, et Ryo, Team Lead Finance , pour apprendre progressivement à gérer les opérations financières. Au cœur de tes missions : le suivi et la résolution des tickets finance, de la réception de la demande jusqu’à sa clôture. Tes missions au sein de l’équipe Finance Formé·e dès ton arrivée, tu prendras progressivement en charge les missions suivantes : Gérer les tickets finance : traiter les demandes reçues sur Slack et Front : remboursements clients, factures manquantes, doublons de facturation ou demandes de plan de paiement. L’objectif collectif : ne laisser aucun ticket ouvert à la fin de la semaine ; Fiabiliser nos données : identifier et corriger les incohérences pour disposer de données financières fiables et à jour ; Participer aux opérations financières : contribuer à la facturation clients, au suivi de la trésorerie et au paiement des fournisseurs ; Contribuer au reporting : participer à la préparation des reportings et à la réalisation d’analyses simples pour accompagner le suivi de l’activité ; Découvrir d’autres sujets Finance : selon ta progression, participer aux échanges avec le cabinet comptable et les auditeurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de nos processus grâce aux outils no-code ou à l’IA. Ton parcours d’apprentissage Pas besoin de tout maîtriser avant de nous rejoindre : ce stage est justement là pour te permettre d’apprendre ! Un accompagnement dès le premier jour : tu découvriras nos outils, nos processus et les bons réflexes avec l’appui de Ryo ; Une montée en compétences progressive : tu apprendras à comprendre les demandes, à identifier les actions nécessaires et à suivre les sujets jusqu’à leur résolution ; Une découverte concrète de la finance en start-up : au fil de tes missions, tu te familiariseras avec notre business model SaaS et ses implications financières ; Une ouverture sur l’amélioration continue : tu pourras poser tes questions, partager tes idées et contribuer à la construction d’une jeune équipe en croissance. This is a product engineering role. Unlike our Forward Deployed Engineers, you are not embedded with clients or responsible for running deployments in the field. You turn operational needs and field feedback into a durable core product. What this looks like in practice: Own end-to-end features on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from scoping and interaction choices through backend implementation and production Spend significant time on the front end, building clear, reliable workflows for users working with complex information under pressure Solve real geospatial problems: move data between backend and frontend through tile servers and use PostGIS for demanding spatial queries Build and harden ML and LLM workflow orchestration, including retries, queueing, and long-running jobs with LangGraph and LangChain Design for on-prem and appliance deployment, where hardware, connectivity, and resource constraints matter as much as cloud scalability Work closely with product, design, and forward-deployed teams to turn user signal into features that work across clients Who We're Looking For We filter hardest on mission drive, low ego, attention to detail, and first-principles problem solving. Along with the chance to close exciting deals and solve meaningful problems, we also offer accelerators above 100% quota attainment.</p> <p>You will report to the Senior Director, Emerging Enterprise, South Europe.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assess your territory and develop a successful execution strategy&nbsp;</li> <li>Use a solution-based approach to selling and creating value for new logo accounts&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify and close quick, small wins while managing longer, complex sales cycles</li> <li>Track all customer details including use case, purchase time frames, next steps, and forecasting in Salesforce</li> <li>Exceed activity and quarterly revenue targets</li> <li>Promote the value of the Databricks' Data Intelligence Platform&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure 100% satisfaction among all customers</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of the data platform and cloud ecosystems</li> <li>Some exposure to the software industry and some basic concepts of selling SaaS, Data and Business Value</li> <li>Basic understanding on how to research company information and identifying key stakeholders</li> <li>Competent with prospecting research and ability to map out key stakeholders</li> <li>Adept in selling to technical buyers&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of MEDDPICC</li> <li>Experience exceeding sales targets/quotas</li> <li>Bachelor's Degree or relevant work experience</li> <li>Fluency in English and French is required</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</p> <p><strong><u>À propos de WPP Media :</u></strong></p> <p><strong>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. </strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.&nbsp;</p> <p>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.&nbsp;</p> <p>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.</p> <p>Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Être Extraordinaire</strong>&nbsp;en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li><strong>Créer un environnement Ouvert</strong>&nbsp;en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li><strong>Diriger avec Optimisme</strong>&nbsp;en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Rôle et missions&nbsp;: </u></strong></p> <p>Vous prendrez la responsabilité du compte MGM au sein de l’équipe OpenDoor (entité qui gère l’ensemble des LOB d’Amazon au sein de WPP Media France).</p> <p>Sur ce portefeuille d'envergure, nous recherchons un&nbsp;<strong>Business Director</strong>&nbsp;<strong>– Client Lead </strong>pour incarner le conseil de haut niveau, guider les recommandations stratégiques et accompagner la montée en compétences d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire.</p> <p>Vos missions principales :</p> <ol> <li><strong> Vision Stratégique, Écriture &amp; Prise de Hauteur :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Rédiger et porter les recommandations stratégiques globales et spécifique à chaque sortie cinéma en apportant une vraie prise de hauteur 360°.</li> <li>Concevoir des présentations et des synthèses stratégiques à fort impact destinées aux directions marketing, comités de direction, instances internationales et réseaux de partenaires/franchisés.</li> <li>Valoriser, structurer et incarner avec conviction l'ensemble des travaux produits par l'agence pour sublimer la valeur délivrée aux clients.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Appétence Innovation &amp; Développement de la Valeur Client :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Démontrer une forte curiosité et une appétence naturelle pour les sujets d'innovation média et les enjeux stratégiques clés du moment :&nbsp;<strong>Influence &amp; Content / Opérations Spéciales, Event…</strong></li> <li>Dans une démarche conseil créatrice de valeur (et non de pur push commercial), savoir détecter dans les échanges clients les besoins émergents pour co-construire des solutions sur-mesure avec l'appui des équipes d'experts internes (Data, Studio, Activation).</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Leadership Managérial &amp; Coaching Orienté Développement :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Encadrer et animer une équipe (Account Directors, Account Managers, Executives, Alternants).</li> <li>S'appuyer sur la forte autonomie de l'équipe dans la gestion opérationnelle du quotidien pour adopter une posture de&nbsp;<strong>mentor et de coach</strong>.</li> <li>Identifier les axes de progression individuels — notamment sur la prise de hauteur stratégique, l'écriture et la formalisation des recommandations — et accompagner le développement des collaborateurs seniors pour les aider à franchir des caps majeurs.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Coordination 360 &amp; Orchestration Interne :</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Assurer l'orchestration globale des réponses plurimédias (Online &amp; Offline) en faisant le lien fluide entre le conseil, le planning stratégique, la création et les équipes d'activation technique (Social, Programmatique, TV/Vidéo).</li> </ul> <p>Profil Recherché :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience :</strong>&nbsp;10 à 12 ans d'expérience en agence média sur des fonctions de conseil, de stratégie média et de relation client.</li> <li><strong>Expertise dans l’industrie du Cinéma</strong>, idéalement ayant déjà piloté un compte Entertainment (distributeur cinéma).</li> <li><strong>Expertise Média 360 :</strong>&nbsp;Solide culture générale des médias (Off &amp; Online).</li> <li><strong>Qualités Rédactionnelles &amp; Synthèse :</strong>&nbsp;Excellence reconnue dans la réflexion et l'écriture stratégique, capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à porter des dossiers stratégiques de haut niveau.</li> <li><strong>Posture Managériale :</strong>&nbsp; Capacité avérée à faire progresser ses équipes par l'accompagnement et le coaching plutôt que par le micro-management.</li> <li><strong>Langues :</strong>&nbsp;Anglais professionnel obligatoire.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</u></strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.</p> <p>Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p><strong>Nos avantages comprennent :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Télétravail :</strong>&nbsp;jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.</li> <li><strong>Congés offerts :</strong>&nbsp;2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.</li> <li><strong>Ancienneté :</strong>&nbsp;Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.</li> <li><strong>Santé &amp; Équité :</strong>&nbsp;5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.</li> <li><strong>Politique handicap :</strong>&nbsp;3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.</li> <li><strong>Engagement sociétal :</strong>&nbsp;Missions solidaires possibles via le programme&nbsp;<em>We care and we act</em>.</li> <li><strong>Tools :</strong>&nbsp;Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Process de recrutement :</u></strong></p> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement :</strong>&nbsp;Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et échanger sur le poste.</li> <li><strong>Entretiens Opérationnels :</strong>&nbsp;Une rencontre avec les leads des comptes à gérer. Au moins un entretien physique est prévu dans nos locaux.</li> <li><strong>Étude de cas :</strong>&nbsp;Réalisation d'un Business Case stratégique pour évaluer votre capacité d'analyse, de synthèse, la qualité de votre écriture et votre vision média.</li> </ol> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle. &nbsp;</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>. &nbsp;</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.&nbsp;<br><br>#<span class="mark1c5ktfqef" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="" data-ogsbtc="" data-ogsbrc="" data-ogsbbc="" data-ogsblc="">LI</span>-<span class="markdz0rokyru" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="" data-ogsbtc="" data-ogsbrc="" data-ogsbbc="" data-ogsblc="">Promoted</span>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Account Development Representative - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.&nbsp;</p> <p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.&nbsp;</p> <p>We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career: </strong>If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.</li> <li><strong>You love talking to people: </strong>In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You treat rejection as a learning experience:</strong> In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>Drive pipeline through personalised outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn</li> <li>Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.</li> <li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li> <li>Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li> <li>6-12 months sales experience as a minimum</li> <li>Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales</li> <li>Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, verbal and written</li> <li>Curious and able to ask insightful questions</li> <li>A champion of a Growth Mindset</li> <li>Highly proficient in English and fluent in French</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in closing-sales roles</li> <li>Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)</li> <li>Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment</li> <li>Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways</li> <li>Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADR pathways</strong></p> <p>Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.</p> <ul> <li><strong>ADR I</strong> representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The next level in the program is <strong>ADR II</strong>, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The highest level within our organization is <strong>ADR III</strong>. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.</li> </ul> <p>Please submit an English CV with your application.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our&nbsp;<a href="https://samsara.com/blog/avoiding-fake-job-offers">blog post here</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Für unser motiviertes Group Fitness Team in Lenzburg  suchen wir ab sofort eine leidenschaftliche und sportbegeisterte Person als Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d) unter anderem für die folgenden Kurse zu folgenden Zeiten:

BODYPUMP und ZUMBA.

Du möchtest lieber flexibel als Selbstständige/r arbeiten? Kein Problem – alternativ zur Festanstellung bieten wir dir auch eine freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit zu einem attraktiven höheren Stundenlohn an. Sprich uns gerne direkt darauf an.   • Du leitest die Group Fitness Kurse und vermittelst dein Fachwissen mit grosser Begeisterung

  • Du bist für unsere Mitglieder da und betreust sie vor, während und nach deinen Kursen

  • Du bereitest deine Kurse vor, hältst die Gruppendynamik aufrecht und motivierst deine Teilnehmer:innen während des Kurses

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der Sauberkeit und Hygieneregeln im Kursraum

  • Du kennst unsere Angebote und unsere Philosophie und kannst diese den Mitgliedern vermitteln

  • Du sorgst idealerweise selbstständig für deine Stellvertretungen und bist auch bereit bei Bedarf selbst als Stellvertretung einzuspringen

  • Du hast bereits fundierte Erfahrung als Groupfitness Instructor für die aufgeführten Kursarten und kannst Group Fitness Diplome oder nachweisbare Diplome im Bereich Zumba und Bodypump vorweisen

  • Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse

  • Wir bieten dir gratis Training in all unseren Studios

raw.title: SAP Analytics Consultant
raw.description:
We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

  • Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

  • Remote working after the onboarding phase

  • Opportunities to shape the client’s analytics architecture and future roadmap
