raw.title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
raw.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

  • Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

  • ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

  • Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

    •  

    Technical Customization & Custom Development

  • Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

  • Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

  • Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

    •  

    API & Ecosystem Integrations

  • Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

  • Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

  • Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

    •  

    Platform Operations & System Health

  • Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

  • Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

  • Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Core Technical Competencies

  • Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

  • Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

  • Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

  • MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

    •  

    Experience

  • 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

  • Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

  • Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

    •  

    Key Personality Traits

  • Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

  • Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

  • Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

On a daily basis, you will

  • Partner with two Major Account Managers in a pod model to build and execute account plans that give full coverage of key accounts and their business units

  • Generate new leads and opportunities in entities of key accounts that are not yet Sonar customers, using a multi-channel approach (LinkedIn, email, video, cold calls and meetings) to convert identified prospects into new logos

  • Work with channel partners to generate and grow pipeline within the accounts you cover

  • Engage and grow entities that already run Sonar instances, identifying new teams, use cases, products and editions

  • Qualify opportunities with BANT and MEDDPICC to understand the customer's needs, pains, decision process, economic buyer and champion

  • Run discovery calls and demos, and guide prospects through proofs of concept and trials with Solutions Engineers, validating Sonar's value against agreed success criteria

  • Size and quote customer software license needs

  • Build the business case and mutual action plan with the customer, then drive the deal through stakeholder alignment, security and legal review, negotiation with procurement, and signature

  • Capture all account and opportunity information accurately in Salesforce (stage, next steps, forecast category, MEDDPICC fields), and use it to set daily activity and forecast the pipeline

  • Support Marketing with account-based, customer-focused campaigns, and work with SDRs, Customer Success and Sales Operations to hand over smoothly after the sale

  • Meet or exceed quarterly and yearly targets for pipeline creation and bookings

  • Share customer and competitive insights, and proactively build, grow and share sales team best practices


    • The skills you will demonstrate

  • Have 2 to 5 years of experience in a B2B sales role (Inside Sales, SDR/BDR moving into an AE role, Account Executive or Account Manager), ideally in a SaaS or subscription model

  • Have a proven track record of creating pipeline and closing deals, with exposure to the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation

  • Know a structured qualification methodology such as BANT and MEDDPICC, and apply it consistently to understand customer needs, pains and decision processes

  • Have experience selling a technical product to a technical buyer, as well as to business stakeholders such as security teams and procurement

  • Have proven prospecting skills across channels and tools such as Outreach, ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn, calling and networking

  • Be familiar with selling to and negotiating with mid-market and enterprise customers, including deals above 20k USD

  • Communicate confidently with executive-level contacts and tailor value messages to the persona, with both bottom-up and top-down approaches

  • Be comfortable running discovery calls, demos and technical evaluations or POCs alongside a Solutions Engineer

  • Be able to negotiate commercial terms and navigate procurement, legal and security reviews through to signature

  • Have Salesforce expertise and be highly organized: manage many accounts and opportunities in parallel, with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting

  • Be customer-centric: we want happy customers

  • Show strong communication and listening skills, handle objections well, and welcome feedback and coaching

  • Be a self-driven, proactive and hungry team player who works well in a pod structure with senior Account Managers and cares about team and company goals

  • Have experience selling software development tooling or selling into the development side of IT, and closing deals internationally (a plus)

  • Be curious about how AI-assisted development changes code quality and security

title: Autonomy Engineer Intern, Reinforcement Learning, 2027 (Zurich)
description: Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders , soldiers in battlefield scenarios , and beyond . About the role: Skydio builds the world’s most advanced autonomous drones used across inspection, public safety, defense, cinematography, and more. Your research won’t languish in a paper: it will fly , shaping how pilots and operators complete real missions in complex environments. Develop and deploy reinforcement learning (and adjacent policy-learning methods) that make Skydio aircraft plan, navigate, and control themselves more intelligently, safely, reliably, and efficiently across our ecosystem: handheld apps, ground control, cloud autonomy services, and fleet workflows. How you'll make an impact: Navigation & avoidance in the wild: Train policies that adapt online to cluttered 3D scenes (forests, bridges, urban canyons), complementing our stack for robust obstacle avoidance and dynamic goal-seeking. RL-augmented planning: Fuse learned cost shaping / value functions with trajectory optimization for smooth, agile flight with tight safety envelopes and mission constraints. Sim to Real at scale: Build scalable datasets and training loops with Isaac Lab, domain randomization, residual learning, and safety filters; validate on real drones weekly. Human-in-the-loop shared control: Learn assistive policies that blend pilot intent, autonomy priors, and uncertainty-aware behaviors for intuitive control handoffs. Fleet & multi-agent: Explore decentralized coordination for coverage, pursuit, and collaborative mapping with minimal comms. What makes this internship different: Real hardware cadence: Prototype in sim, then flight test on production-ready aircraft and edge compute. Your work is meant to make a difference in the real world, not just in simulation. Safety-first learning: We pair RL with formal constraints, estimation of uncertainty, and conservative action filters for dependable deployment in human environments. Cross-disciplinary mentorship: Collaborate with perception, mapping, controls, and product teams to close the loop from research to field ops. What makes you a strong fit: PhD student in Robotics, Machine Learning, Controls, or related field. Strong fundamentals in RL , control theory, and motion planning; comfort with safety/robustness concepts. Proficient in Python (PyTorch/JAX/Ray RLlib) and at least one of C++ or CUDA. Hands-on experience with robotics simulation (Isaac Lab/MuJoCo/PyBullet) and sim2real techniques. description: The Role As part of the local Critical Operations Team, Critical Operations Technicians (COT) ensure the data center is operating smoothly and efficiently 24/7/365, with no downtime of critical services. Critical Operations Technicians are responsible for the inspection, operation and maintenance of all equipment associated with the data center. They are expected to be technically strong with great troubleshooting abilities and a desire to learn and work in a demanding yet rewarding team environment. The Critical Operations Team's on-site presence is organized in a 24/7 shift schedule, ensuring coverage at all hours of the day, year-round. Key Responsibilities Perform operational, preventive, and corrective maintenance on all mechanical and electrical equipment as assigned. Conduct daily and weekly routine inspections on critical equipment, rooms, and systems, ensuring compliance with quality and efficiency standards. Monitor, respond to, and act on alarms from Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS), and other monitoring tools. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical systems, interpreting diagrams and schematics to detect, repair, and report faulty equipment or unusual conditions. Carry out isolation and reinstatement of electrical, cooling, fire alarm, and gas suppression systems when required and authorized. Manage and react to emergency situations involving critical equipment, escalating incidents according to established processes and procedures. Ensure all plant equipment operates at maximum efficiency and in compliance with industry best practices and regulations. Escort personnel when required for security or operational reasons (e.g. clients and vendors). Ensure compliance with housekeeping rules, facility manuals, and service agreements, managing vendor reports and follow-ups. Maintain accurate logs of completed and pending work in the Facility Management System. Support the preparation of technical work quotations and execution of assigned projects and programs. Maintain proper storage of documentation related to building infrastructure, systems, and tools. Participate in ongoing training, development, and drills to stay updated in relevant disciplines. Ensure a proper handover of relevant information within the team as needed. Job Practicalities / Skills, Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications Preferably in possession of trade certificate and/or vocational education degree within Electrical or Mechanical discipline or equivalent. Preferably experienced with electrical or mechanical systems in a critical environment and/or within a data center. In-depth knowledge of various maintenance fundamentals to deal with service and repairs. Ability to perform a range of complex work activities with some degree of personal responsibility and autonomy. Ability to work alone or collaboratively in a team. Attention to detail while maintaining a broad perspective Desire and ability to learn new skills and systems. Effective interpersonal skills for collaboration with vendors and clients. IT and computer skills (MS Office suite) with ability to work in and learn various operating software tools and systems. Good written and verbal skills in English and local language (German/Scandinavian/French/Italian languages are a plus). Service-oriented mindset with a focus on client satisfaction. Preferred start date: November 2026. However, an earlier start date may be discussed and arranged depending on the candidate's availability. All applications will be treated confidentially. Je werkt mee in de operatie en coördineert daarnaast de volgende werkzaamheden;

  • Orderpicken

  • Controleren van ontvangen goederen

  • Lossen van containers en zorgdragen dat de goederen op de juiste locatie in het magazijn worden weggezet en geregistreerd in het WMS systeem

  • Laden van vrachtwagens

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een correcte urenregistratie van je afdeling;

  • Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan een optimale inrichting van het magazijn en het WMS systeem;

  • Je rapporteert aan en werkt nauw samen met de Operations Manager en voert op regelmatige basis overleg over de dagelijkse operationele aangelegenheden;

  • Je signaleert verbeterpunten en lost knelpunten op;

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de eigen veiligheid en die van collega’s conform de daarvoor opgestelde instructies;

  • Daarnaast werk je met goederen van derden die via diverse kanalen (weg, zee en/of luchttransport) vervoerd worden, waarbij de regelgeving uiterst nauwkeurig opgevolgd dient te worden.


Wat wij jou bieden

Geodis biedt je een uitdagende bedrijfscultuur waar klantgerichtheid, flexibiliteit, initiatief, doorzettingsvermogen en collegialiteit gewaardeerd worden. We bieden een competitief salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden pakket en hebben oog voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.


Over GEODIS

GEODIS is één van de grootste Supply Chain organisaties in de wereld. Als onderdeel van SNCF Logistics, is Geodis nr. 1 in Frankrijk en nr. 4 in Europa. Met meer dan 40.000 professionals zijn wij aanwezig in 67 landen en hebben we een global netwerk in 120 landen. Met 5 business lines, Supply Chain Optimization, Freight Forwarding, Contract Logistics, Distribution & Express en Road Transport, managen wij dagelijks vol passie en commitment de supply chain van onze klanten. Onze missie: ‘we help our clients succeed by overcoming logistical constraints’. Onze signature: 'Keep Rising!'


  • Je beschikt over een MBO 4 opleiding, bij voorkeur richting Logistiek;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie;

  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B en een vorkheftruck & reachtruck certificaat;

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, bent stressbestendig en flexibel ingesteld;

raw.title: Product Manager Digital Platforms
raw.description:
🌊 Who are we?


We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

AURA is the platform Aquablu runs on. It replaced about 15 tools with one system of record, gives every colleague their own AI agent, and connects to hundreds of our systems in the field. Version 2.0 just went live. What it becomes next is your call.

You own AURA’s direction: what gets built, why, and in what order. Then you build it yourself. You’ll write features with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and deploy them to production. Our engineering team sets the architecture, reviews your work, and makes sure the platform stays safe while you move fast.

You don’t need to have been an engineer. You do need to want to ship code. You’ll report to our Head of Digital Product.


What you'll Do

  • Own the roadmap: prioritize by business value and user pain. Kill ideas that don’t earn their place.

  • Find the real problem: work directly with the teams who use AURA every day.

  • Build features yourself: go from idea to working feature with AI, not to a spec handed off to someone else.

  • Deploy to production: ship your own features, with engineers reviewing and guiding your work.

  • Keep leadership aligned: explain your priorities and trade-offs from decision to launch.

  • Measure and iterate: define success for every feature, check whether it landed, and go again.

What You Bring

  • Platform experience: three to five years as a PM on a live software product, ideally B2B, SaaS, or internal platforms.

  • Clear judgment: you commit when there’s no perfect answer.

  • Stakeholder trust: you earn it with senior stakeholders and explain decisions plainly.

  • Technical comfort: you’re comfortable with code, data models, and integrations, even if engineering was never your title.

  • AI already in your work: you’ve built something with AI tools, even a prototype or side project, and you want to make it your day job.

Bonus: connected hardware or IoT experience.

✨ Why join us?

You will be part of a young, fun and ambitious team which aims to change the way people consume water!

💸 A salary base of 63-85k€(incl. 8% holiday allowance)

🌴 26 paid holiday days

📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan — everyone shares in what we’re building

🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches

💪 Urban Sports Club membership

🚀 Access to the Corporate Benefits platform for endless savings

🚆 Travel compensation >10km

👴 A pension plan by Zwitserleven.

💧 Endless amount of our very own flavoured water !

💙 Check out out our Youtube to get a feeling for the culture at Aquablu!

title: Power BI Developer
description: Over Verzuimdata Verzuimdata is een gespecialiseerde dienstverlener in het uitwisselen van verzuim-, loon- en werknemersgegevens tussen werkgevers, verzekeraars, arbodiensten en de overheid. Naast standaard dienstverlening leveren wij oplossingen ter ondersteuning van de dagelijkse processen van verzekeraars, volmachten en intermediairs, waaronder polisbeheer, premie- en schadeberekening, schadelastbeheersing, diverse dashboards en een digitale documentenkluis. Wat je gaat doen Als Power BI Developer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van datagedreven oplossingen binnen ons team in Ridderkerk. Je werkt aan heldere dashboards en rapportages die onze processen op het gebied van gegevensuitwisseling inzichtelijk maken. Wat we vragen Ervaring met Power BI en het bouwen van dashboards Affiniteit met data-analyse en business intelligence Zelfstandige en nauwkeurige werkhouding Wat we bieden Je werkt op basis van een vast contract van 40 uur per week met een proeftijd van 1 maand. Je ontvangt 33 vakantiedagen per jaar. Er is een bedrijfspensioenregeling aanwezig. Je krijgt de beschikking over een laptop van de zaak en thuiswerkuitrusting. Geniet op locatie van gratis drankjes en maak gebruik van de aanwezige cafetaria. Salaris Het salaris bedraagt EUR 3,000–3,500 per maand. Jouw eerste maanden bij Verzuimdata In je eerste maanden maak je kennis met onze datastromen en systemen, en ga je direct aan de slag met het ontwerpen van overzichtelijke dashboards voor onze gebruikers. title: Junior Public Sector Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p data-start="0" data-end="543"><strong data-start="0" data-end="20">What Is The Role</strong><br data-start="20" data-end="23">Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a Jnr Public Sector Account Exec. You’ll own a greenfield Dutch public sector territory: municipalities, healthcare, education and research. This is a hunter seat with loads of potential, Elastic has the momentum in this segment. You’ll open doors, build champions, and turn Search, Observability and Security use cases into new projects, with a main focus on applying AI.</p> <p data-start="550" data-end="578"><strong data-start="550" data-end="576">What You Will Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and run a territory plan that prioritizes where to hunt first, using account tiering and contact coverage.</li> <li>Generate your own pipeline through outbound, events, partners and public sector networks. Many accounts have no contacts yet, so you’ll build coverage from scratch.</li> <li>Run full-cycle deals with MEDDPICC discipline: economic buyer, champion, decision process, paper process.</li> <li>Navigate Dutch public procurement: tenders, Europese aanbesteding, framework agreements, and partner and reseller routes.</li> <li>Expand the existing customers, especially in universities and research.</li> <li>Forecast accurately and keep Salesforce clean.</li> <li>Work with Solutions Architects, partners and Elastic specialists to land technical wins.</li> </ul> <p data-start="1852" data-end="1872"><strong data-start="1852" data-end="1870">What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>We want to hire a sales talent, with &lt;5 years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven new logo track record or proven SDR capacity</li> <li>A preference for Public sector experience in the Netherlands (government, healthcare or education). You understand procurement cycles and can build a deal around them.</li> <li>Experience selling technical solutions in search, observability, security, data or cloud.</li> <li>Fluent Dutch and English. You’ll write and sell in Dutch to Dutch-speaking buyers.</li> <li>Strong qualification habits. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.</p> <p>The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.</p></div><div class="title">The typical starting On-Target Earnings range (Base Salary + Variable) for this role is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€95.900</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€151.700 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. description: Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Compliance at Mollie is a competitive advantage — and you'll be the one building it. As a Senior Regulatory Compliance Officer, you'll be at the heart of how we scale responsibly across Europe, turning complex regulatory requirements into practical, automated solutions that actually work for the business. You'll own the frameworks, lead the conversations, and make sure compliance moves at the same pace we do. You'll also lead and develop a team of junior and mid-level compliance officers — coaching them, reviewing their work, and helping them grow. Your expertise across AML/CFT, sanctions, and regulatory advisory will set the standard for how the team operates and how compliance is embedded across Mollie. This is a role where your work has real reach. The frameworks you build, the policies you shape, and the culture you foster will directly support over 350,000 businesses growing with less friction and more freedom. What you'll ship A robust, scalable compliance framework across AML/CFT, sanctions, and governance — designed to support Mollie's rapid European expansion Clear, actionable policies and controls that translate PSD2/3, AMLD6 and EBA Guidelines into practical business requirements Proactive risk assessments and thematic reviews that identify and close compliance gaps before they become problems Compliance embedded into product development lifecycles — working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Operations to make it happen by design, not as an afterthought High-quality regulatory reporting and senior management deliverables, prepared with precision and delivered on time A stronger, more capable compliance team — through structured mentorship, coaching, and quality oversight that raises the bar across the board What you'll bring 7+ years of compliance experience within a regulated financial institution — Fintech, PSP, EMI, or (neo)bank Strong, hands-on knowledge of European regulatory frameworks, including PSD2, AMLD, EBA Guidelines and MiCAR Solid experience across both financial crime (AML/CFT, sanctions) and broader regulatory compliance advisory The ability to translate complex regulations into clear, practical solutions — without overcomplicating it Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge and influence senior leadership when it matters A proven track record of mentoring or managing junior compliance professionals and elevating team performance Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy. If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below. Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like. AI at Mollie We believe in Always Be Shipping. AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Compliance at Mollie is a competitive advantage — and you'll be the one building it. As a Senior Regulatory Compliance Officer, you'll be at the heart of how we scale responsibly across Europe, turning complex regulatory requirements into practical, automated solutions that actually work for the business. You'll own the frameworks, lead the conversations, and make sure compliance moves at the same pace we do.

You'll also lead and develop a team of junior and mid-level compliance officers — coaching them, reviewing their work, and helping them grow. Your expertise across AML/CFT, sanctions, and regulatory advisory will set the standard for how the team operates and how compliance is embedded across Mollie.

This is a role where your work has real reach. The frameworks you build, the policies you shape, and the culture you foster will directly support over 350,000 businesses growing with less friction and more freedom.

What you'll ship

  • A robust, scalable compliance framework across AML/CFT, sanctions, and governance — designed to support Mollie's rapid European expansion

  • Clear, actionable policies and controls that translate PSD2/3, AMLD6 and EBA Guidelines into practical business requirements

  • Proactive risk assessments and thematic reviews that identify and close compliance gaps before they become problems

  • Compliance embedded into product development lifecycles — working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Operations to make it happen by design, not as an afterthought

  • High-quality regulatory reporting and senior management deliverables, prepared with precision and delivered on time

  • A stronger, more capable compliance team — through structured mentorship, coaching, and quality oversight that raises the bar across the board


What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of compliance experience within a regulated financial institution — Fintech, PSP, EMI, or (neo)bank

  • Strong, hands-on knowledge of European regulatory frameworks, including PSD2, AMLD, EBA Guidelines and MiCAR

  • Solid experience across both financial crime (AML/CFT, sanctions) and broader regulatory compliance advisory

  • The ability to translate complex regulations into clear, practical solutions — without overcomplicating it

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge and influence senior leadership when it matters

  • A proven track record of mentoring or managing junior compliance professionals and elevating team performance

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping. AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden. We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst. Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes. De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de CCO en HR De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de CCO en een externe adviseur. Als laatste een finale selectie en arbeidsvoorwaarden worden vastgesteld in afstemming met de CEO en het MT. Slotopmerking Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline  met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je! Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer ( Jouw profiel   ·      Aantoonbare resultaten in digitale marketing op strategisch niveau (focus op wat je hebt neergezet). ·      Ervaring met het leiden/opbouwen van een marketingteam, bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS/tech. ·      Bewezen succes met leadfunnel‑bouw en marketingautomatisering. ·      Aantoonbare resultaten met product‑led growth. ·      Sterk in performance marketing (paid search/social, SEO/SEA, e‑mailautomatisering, retargeting). ·      Datagedreven, ROI‑gedreven, vertaalt inzichten naar actie. ·      Pré: HubSpot, Dynamics, Userpilot, AI in marketing (o.a. Breeze AI), B2B‑contentstrategie.   Qua motivatie en ambitie zoeken we iemand om marketingkennis intern op te bouwen en afhankelijkheid van bureaus te verkleinen. Die het team neerzet, begeleid en ontwikkeld. Die het ruime marketingbudget inzet en optimaliseert. Daar zit de change en de uitdaging.   Qua persoonlijkheid zoeken we iemand die verbinding maakt met de rest van de organisatie, die kwaliteit, energie en humor brengt; cultuur omarmt en ownership heeft. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy, execution, and team development for a rapidly growing organization of 70+ engineers spanning multiple global Planet offices. You will oversee the development, scaling, and delivery of our critical existing solutions, including Area Monitoring Service (AMS) for EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) compliance, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), and a portfolio of Derived Data Products. You will also drive our "zero to one" product discovery, partnering closely with Product Management, Design, and Science teams to incubate, architect, and launch new, emerging solutions built on top of Planet’s high-frequency imagery and derived data products. AI is central to how Planet builds solutions, and you will make it a primary way your teams discover, build, and deliver for customers. This position is vital to delivering innovative applications to civil governments and commercial customers worldwide.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem, or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and scale a global engineering organization of 70+ engineers, managers, and directors across multiple geographies and time zones.</li> <li>Set a high bar for performance and accountability. Disaster and Wildfire solutions, and the derived data portfolio.</li> <li>Champion and lead "zero to one" engineering discovery, building the technical foundation and prototypes for new emerging commercial and civil government products.</li> <li>Partner on a daily basis with Product Management, Design, and GTM teams to define product direction, prioritize feature development, and align technical strategy with business goals.</li> <li>Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and secure for government and enterprise use, guiding architectural decisions and engineering best practices.</li> <li>Align your team's daily output with Planet’s mission of using space to help life on earth, directly enabling governments and businesses to make critical, timely decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of relevant software engineering work experience, including 8+ years of supervisory or leadership experience managing multiple layers of engineering management.</li> <li>Experience leading and scaling distributed engineering teams of 50+ employees across multiple geographic locations and time zones.</li> <li>Hands-on engagement with AI tools in your own work, and experience leading engineering teams through AI adoption.</li> <li>Track record of "zero to one" product development, including the technical discovery, architecture, and successful launch of new software solutions.</li> <li>Background in building and delivering geospatial platforms, data analytics solutions, or enterprise SaaS products.</li> <li>Experience delivering tailored solutions to individual customers, meeting or exceeding their expectations and integrating new building blocks back into the solution commons.</li> <li>A growth mindset. You experiment, learn quickly, and change course when the evidence says to.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners to translate complex business and user requirements into actionable technical roadmaps.</li> <li>Experience overseeing operational reliability, cloud infrastructure, and software deployment lifecycles for enterprise-grade applications.</li> <li>Ability to drive software delivery metrics, maintain high operational availability/SLAs, and foster rigorous engineering practices.</li> <li>Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain engineering talent at all levels while fostering an inclusive team culture.</li> <li>Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Success building large scale civil government solutions leveraging forward deployed engineering.&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with the unique regulatory, compliance, and security requirements of government technology solutions globally.</li> <li>Experience building sovereign systems for governments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Netherlands Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€120.100</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€150.100 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging.&nbsp;<br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.&nbsp; If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!&nbsp; At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.&nbsp; We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.&nbsp; We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Daarbij houd je overzicht, denk je mee over technische oplossingen en zorg je voor een prettige samenwerking. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici; Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten; Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten; Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers; Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn; Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling; Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen; Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen. Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd. Wat neem je mee? Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende: Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider; Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling; Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren; Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling; Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen. Campus Installatietechniek is een installatiebedrijf gevestigd in Barneveld. Als Teamleider krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken, verbeteringen door te voeren en jouw eigen stempel te drukken op de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega's die elkaar kennen, helpen en samen zorgen voor tevreden klanten. Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (185 bedrijven, 9.000 collega’s), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Dit betekent dat je bij ons de voordelen van een grote organisatie ervaart – denk aan opleidingsmogelijkheden, een stabiele basis en top secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden – terwijl je tegelijkertijd de vrijheid, dynamiek en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt om je eigen stempel te drukken bij het lokale bedrijf. title: Chief Information Security Officer
description: Make security the reason people trust Ockto Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture. As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide. What you'll do You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you: Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible. Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to. Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time. Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls. Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you. You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. What you get You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto. •     Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us. •     A real mandate : a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk. •     Influence on what we build next , as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions. •     Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work. •     Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance. Without this role, quality depends on manual testing on release day, bugs show up in staging or production, and the move to automated testing stalls. This is an interim position: the duration is still to be confirmed, and the role ends once the assignment is complete.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the product teams and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new features on staging, going beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Write and review Playwright tests (TypeScript) in the frontend repo, and review developer-written tests in pull requests

  • Monitor the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions, triage failures the same day, and fix flaky tests at the root cause

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan for each release, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what is worth automating and what stays manual

  • Organise cross-team QA days and coach developers so they own their tests

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining UI test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong manual and exploratory testing, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You have defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

  • Experience leading a shift-left change or coaching developers to own their tests

  • API testing (REST, Postman or similar)

  • Basic security testing (e.g. OWASP ZAP)

  • Mobile app testing (iOS / Android)

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

  • Introduction Call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30 mins)

  • Past Experience & Culture Interview with the team, online or on-site (60 mins)

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Technical Enablement Manager to join our Revenue Enablement team in Amsterdam. Why DataSnipper?

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. .

title: Lead Supply Chain Coördinator
description: Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen, waarbij we onze kracht van de kortste keten van boer tot bord inzetten op een manier waar je trots op kunt zijn. Als Lead Supply Chain Coördinator geef jij leiding aan het team dat iedere dag opnieuw zorgt dat de korte keten tussen leverancier en ons Warehouse zo goed mogelijk loopt. Zo kunnen we onze knetterverse producten altijd op tijd bij onze klanten bezorgen. Je staat zelf midden in de operatie, maar kijkt ook verder: je maakt de supply chain elke dag een stukje slimmer, bouwt aan de processen en manier van werken binnen je team, en zorgt voor een sterke samenwerking met ons warehouse. Zo bouw je mee aan een Supply Chain-afdeling waarmee we kunnen blijven groeien. Wat je gaat doen Als Lead Inbound Supply Chain Coördinator zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat onze leveranciers de juiste producten, op het goede moment, in de juiste hoeveelheid leveren. Hierdoor krijgen onze klanten hun producten vers bezorgd en kunnen we op ons Warehouse de voorraad zo laag mogelijk houden. Dat is een ingewikkelde puzzel die we elke dag een stukje slimmer willen oplossen. Jij geeft het team daarin richting, houdt de dagelijkse operatie scherp en verbetert tegelijk structureel. Je hebt veel contact met externe partijen zoals leveranciers, en met andere teams binnen Crisp zoals ons warehouse en het commerciële team. Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn: Je bent leidinggevende van het Inbound Supply Chain-team. Je coacht en ontwikkelt je teamleden, voert de gesprekken die daarbij horen en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat je van hem of haar verwacht. Je bewaakt samen met het team de dagelijkse supply chain performance en bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van verstoringen. Waar nodig spring je zelf bij om bestellingen scherp te monitoren en snel te schakelen met leveranciers en interne teams. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de continuous improvement van onze dagelijkse supply chain. Je analyseert waar het schuurt, zet verbeteringen op de agenda en zorgt dat ze ook echt landen in de operatie. Je bent eigenaar van de teamprocessen en de way-of-working. Je zorgt voor heldere afspraken, duidelijke rolverdeling en werkwijzen die meegroeien met Crisp. Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking met ons warehouse team. Je stemt structureel af, lost knelpunten samen op en bouwt aan een relatie waarin beide teams elkaar sterker maken. Dit ben jij Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding op zak. Je hebt minimaal 3-5 jaar ervaring binnen Supply Chain, Logistiek of Operations. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je bent een natuurlijke leider. Je geeft richting, coacht je team en haalt het beste uit mensen. Je bent een verbeteraar. Je ziet snel waar processen beter kunnen en voert verbeteringen ook echt door. Je bent nog steeds een echte doener. Je vindt het leuk om mee te draaien in de operatie. Je bent communicatief sterk. Je bent een teamplayer, bouwt makkelijk relaties op en schakelt met gemak met veel verschillende partijen tegelijk. Je hebt talent voor planning en structuur. Je werkt planmatig en gestructureerd en bent altijd voorbereid. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. title: Junior Business Controller
description: Steer our numbers, fuel our growth – so our team can focus on saving birds and stopping drones. As our Jr. Business Controller, you bring data to life and turn financial insights into smart operational decisions. You work closely with your team and colleagues across the business to build accurate forecasts, spot trends, and guide our strategic goals. Reporting directly to the Head of Business Controlling, your sharp financial eye gives our management crew the clarity they need to keep Robin Radar moving forward. What you'll do Financial forecasting and analysis: Collate, analyze, and interpret financial data using preset tools and methods. Drive our budget forecasting and closing processes to keep our growth plans on track. Reporting and dashboarding: Deliver clear management analytics, periodic reports, and visual dashboards. Give leaders across the organization the visibility they need for confident operational oversight. Variance and trend analysis: Run variance analysis to track operational performance. Identify trend deviations early and translate those shifts into actionable steering advice for key stakeholders. Financial policies and internal controls: Advise on financial guidelines and help optimize internal control procedures. Resolve routine queries, handle continuous practice improvements, and keep standards consistently high. Compliance and risk oversight: Review financial data periodically to verify completeness and accuracy. Ensure full alignment with regulatory codes and escalate non-compliance risks before they impact the business. Cross-functional projects and support: Assist with special financial projects across our entities. Guide colleagues to help them make the best possible use of our data management systems every day. What you bring BSc or MSc in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field 1 - 2 years of experience in financial controlling or FP&A, ideally within a multinational environment Strong command of financial modelling, forecasting, and modern reporting tools Fluent in English, both spoken and written Analytical mind with sharp attention to detail and a strategic outlook Proactive team player who takes ownership and works well independently Excellent communicator across cultures, comfortable collaborating with teams across our group companies N.B. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. Our mission is a journey, and there's plenty to learn along the way. If most of this fits, we'd love to hear from you. A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a background check are part of our screening process. We appreciate your understanding. What we offer Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company; Comprehensive pension plan; Commuting allowance; 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days); Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications; High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role; An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks! Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. Our radars and software help prevent bird strikes in aviation, reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife, and protect critical infrastructure from drone threats. Onze organisatie, werkzaamheden en processen zijn continu in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat ook arbeidsrisico's kunnen veranderen. Tijdens deze stage voer jij daarom een onafhankelijke review uit van de bestaande RI&E en het bijbehorende Plan van Aanpak. Je blijft daarbij niet achter je bureau zitten. Je gaat de werkvloer op, voert veiligheidsrondes uit, spreekt met medewerkers en leidinggevenden en analyseert onder andere incidenten, near misses, hazard reports, werkplekinspecties en andere beschikbare veiligheidsinformatie. Je onderzoekt verschillende werkomgevingen binnen NX Filtration, waaronder productie, logistiek, maintenance & facilities, laboratorium/QC en kantoor. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw stage is: “In hoeverre sluit de huidige RI&E van NX Filtration aan op de actuele risico's binnen de organisatie en welke verbetermaatregelen hebben de hoogste prioriteit?” Wie zijn wij NX Filtration produceert membraanfilters die wereldwijd worden gebruikt om de kleinste vervuilingen uit water te filteren. Denk hierbij aan vervuilingen zoals nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Dit heeft geresulteerd in nieuwe en eenvoudige processen voor de behandeling van water, het hergebruik van afvalwater en de productie van drinkwater. Het motto van NX Filtration is “schoon en betaalbaar water voor iedereen”. In 2024 is een geheel nieuwe, zeer moderne fabriek in Hengelo in gebruik genomen. Wat vragen we van jou? Je volgt een relevante HBO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld: Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Milieukunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, of een vergelijkbare technische of veiligheidskundige opleiding. Je hebt interesse in HSE, arbeidsveiligheid, productieprocessen en continu verbeteren. Je werkt analytisch, zorgvuldig en gestructureerd. Je durft medewerkers en leidinggevenden op verschillende niveaus te interviewen. Je kunt waarnemingen objectief vastleggen en vertalen naar concrete en uitvoerbare verbetervoorstellen. Je bent praktisch ingesteld en vindt het leuk om zowel zelfstandig als met verschillende afdelingen samen te werken. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en bij voorkeur ook de Engelse taal. Wat bieden we jou? Een impactvolle stage op het gebied van HSE en arbeidsveiligheid, met een stagevergoeding á €500,00 (o.b.v. 40 uur). title: Client Service Director
description: Wat gebeurt er als je strategisch klantpartnerschap, technologie, dienstverlening en ontwikkeling samenbrengt in één rol? Dan krijg je een functie waarin je écht het verschil kunt maken voor de grootste retailklanten van Centric. Als Client Service Director ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het succes van onze belangrijkste klantrelaties. Je begrijpt de business van de klant, denkt strategisch mee en zorgt dat ambities worden vertaald naar concrete resultaten. Je verbindt mensen, stuurt op kwaliteit en voortgang en houdt grip op zowel de dienstverlening als de financiële prestaties. Wat jij doet Als Client Service Director ben je verantwoordelijk voor het totale succes van jouw klantrelaties. Je bent de strategische gesprekspartner voor grote retailklanten en zorgt ervoor dat klantbehoeften, dienstverlening, projecten en commerciële doelstellingen samenkomen. Je overziet het geheel, verbindt de juiste mensen en neemt de regie wanneer dat nodig is. Van strategisch advies en klanttevredenheid tot operationele voortgang en financiële resultaten: jij zorgt voor samenhang, grip en resultaat. Strategisch klantpartnerschap: je bouwt aan duurzame relaties met grote retailklanten en bent hun gesprekspartner op directie- en managementniveau. Je begrijpt hun strategie, uitdagingen en ambities en vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen en kansen. Regie op dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening op het gebied van hardware en services. Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen en dat de dienstverlening aansluit op de verwachtingen van de klant. Programmamanagement en projectregie: je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten, programma’s en verbeterinitiatieven. Je bewaakt de samenhang, planning, voortgang, risico’s en resultaten en zorgt dat betrokken teams gezamenlijk naar hetzelfde doel werken. Klanttevredenheid en escalatiemanagement: je signaleert knelpunten voordat ze escaleren, neemt de regie wanneer zaken vastlopen en zorgt voor duidelijke afspraken en opvolging. Je vertaalt klantfeedback naar structurele verbeteringen. Samenwerking en stakeholdermanagement: je verbindt de klant met de verschillende teams binnen Centric, waaronder delivery, projectmanagement, techniek, commercie en finance. Je creëert duidelijkheid over prioriteiten, verantwoordelijkheden en resultaten en spreekt betrokkenen aan waar nodig. Financiële verantwoordelijkheid en forecasting: je bewaakt de financiële performance van jouw accounts, waaronder omzet, marges, kosten en contractuele afspraken. Je borgt een actuele en betrouwbare forecast, analyseert afwijkingen en stuurt bij op basis van ontwikkelingen in de dienstverlening, projecten en klantbehoeften. Commerciële ontwikkeling en groei: je signaleert kansen om de samenwerking uit te breiden met aanvullende hardware, services en oplossingen. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete proposities en businesscases en werkt samen met commerciële collega's aan duurzame groei en rendement. Continu verbeteren en vooruitkijken: je kijkt kritisch naar de samenwerking, processen en dienstverlening. Je initieert verbeteringen, adviseert over toekomstige behoeften en zorgt dat Centric zich blijft ontwikkelen als strategische partner van de klant. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën? Dit breng je mee Je bent een ervaren professional die klantgerichtheid, strategisch inzicht en resultaatgerichtheid combineert. Je begrijpt dat grote retailklanten vragen om meer dan goed accountmanagement. Je moet hun business kennen, complexe dienstverlening kunnen overzien en in staat zijn om mensen, processen, projecten en financiële doelstellingen met elkaar te verbinden. Je neemt eigenaarschap, houdt overzicht wanneer belangen uiteenlopen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer bijsturing nodig is. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op directieniveau, maar hebt ook oog voor de dagelijkse praktijk en weet hoe je plannen vertaalt naar concrete resultaten. Ervaring met strategisch accountmanagement, service delivery, programmamanagement of een vergelijkbare integrale klantverantwoordelijkheid. Ervaring met het coördineren van complexe dienstverlening, projecten en verschillende stakeholders. Financieel inzicht en ervaring met budgetbewaking, omzet- en margeontwikkeling en forecasting. raw.title: Client Service Director
raw.description:
Wat gebeurt er als je strategisch klantpartnerschap, technologie, dienstverlening en ontwikkeling samenbrengt in één rol? Dan krijg je een functie waarin je écht het verschil kunt maken voor de grootste retailklanten van Centric.

Als Client Service Director ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het succes van onze belangrijkste klantrelaties. Je begrijpt de business van de klant, denkt strategisch mee en zorgt dat ambities worden vertaald naar concrete resultaten. Je verbindt mensen, stuurt op kwaliteit en voortgang en houdt grip op zowel de dienstverlening als de financiële prestaties.

Wat jij doet

Als Client Service Director ben je verantwoordelijk voor het totale succes van jouw klantrelaties. Je bent de strategische gesprekspartner voor grote retailklanten en zorgt ervoor dat klantbehoeften, dienstverlening, projecten en commerciële doelstellingen samenkomen. Je overziet het geheel, verbindt de juiste mensen en neemt de regie wanneer dat nodig is. Van strategisch advies en klanttevredenheid tot operationele voortgang en financiële resultaten: jij zorgt voor samenhang, grip en resultaat.

  • Strategisch klantpartnerschap: je bouwt aan duurzame relaties met grote retailklanten en bent hun gesprekspartner op directie- en managementniveau. Je begrijpt hun strategie, uitdagingen en ambities en vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen en kansen.

  • Regie op dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening op het gebied van hardware en services. Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen en dat de dienstverlening aansluit op de verwachtingen van de klant.

  • Programmamanagement en projectregie: je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten, programma’s en verbeterinitiatieven. Je bewaakt de samenhang, planning, voortgang, risico’s en resultaten en zorgt dat betrokken teams gezamenlijk naar hetzelfde doel werken.

  • Klanttevredenheid en escalatiemanagement: je signaleert knelpunten voordat ze escaleren, neemt de regie wanneer zaken vastlopen en zorgt voor duidelijke afspraken en opvolging. Je vertaalt klantfeedback naar structurele verbeteringen.

  • Samenwerking en stakeholdermanagement: je verbindt de klant met de verschillende teams binnen Centric, waaronder delivery, projectmanagement, techniek, commercie en finance. Je creëert duidelijkheid over prioriteiten, verantwoordelijkheden en resultaten en spreekt betrokkenen aan waar nodig.

  • Financiële verantwoordelijkheid en forecasting: je bewaakt de financiële performance van jouw accounts, waaronder omzet, marges, kosten en contractuele afspraken. Je borgt een actuele en betrouwbare forecast, analyseert afwijkingen en stuurt bij op basis van ontwikkelingen in de dienstverlening, projecten en klantbehoeften.

  • Commerciële ontwikkeling en groei: je signaleert kansen om de samenwerking uit te breiden met aanvullende hardware, services en oplossingen. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete proposities en businesscases en werkt samen met commerciële collega's aan duurzame groei en rendement.

  • Continu verbeteren en vooruitkijken: je kijkt kritisch naar de samenwerking, processen en dienstverlening. Je initieert verbeteringen, adviseert over toekomstige behoeften en zorgt dat Centric zich blijft ontwikkelen als strategische partner van de klant.

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Client Service Director rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tussen de €6.500,- en €8.000,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag en een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer van € 0,25 netto per kilometer óf een NS Businesscard

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je bent een ervaren professional die klantgerichtheid, strategisch inzicht en resultaatgerichtheid combineert. Je begrijpt dat grote retailklanten vragen om meer dan goed accountmanagement. Je moet hun business kennen, complexe dienstverlening kunnen overzien en in staat zijn om mensen, processen, projecten en financiële doelstellingen met elkaar te verbinden.

Je neemt eigenaarschap, houdt overzicht wanneer belangen uiteenlopen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer bijsturing nodig is. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op directieniveau, maar hebt ook oog voor de dagelijkse praktijk en weet hoe je plannen vertaalt naar concrete resultaten.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met grote retailklanten. Dit is een harde eis. Je kent de dynamiek van grotere retailorganisaties en begrijpt hoe technologie, hardware en IT-dienstverlening bijdragen aan de continuïteit van hun bedrijfsvoering.

  • Ervaring met strategisch accountmanagement, service delivery, programmamanagement of een vergelijkbare integrale klantverantwoordelijkheid.

  • Ervaring met het coördineren van complexe dienstverlening, projecten en verschillende stakeholders.

  • Financieel inzicht en ervaring met budgetbewaking, omzet- en margeontwikkeling en forecasting.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om te schakelen tussen directie, management en operationele teams.

  • Een proactieve en resultaatgerichte instelling: je signaleert risico’s, ziet kansen en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.
